Citations deduplicates multiple links to the same URL

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.markdown.content.inspect
puts result.markdown.citations.inspect
```
